description: Resolve a ship-to (e.g. 'US-CA', 'CA-ON', 'MX', 'EU-DE', 'UK', 'KR', 'JP', 'SG', 'CH') to the gate's jurisdiction (US · CA · MX · EU · UK · KR · JP · SG · CH; UK is the jurisdiction name; the ISO 3166-1 code is accepted as input, machine fields carry the ISO code and jurisdiction_label carries UK), the EU member and any state, provincial or cantonal overlay.
name: resolve_jurisdiction
title: Resolve Jurisdiction
